data.name: Aamna
data.gender_notes: Aamna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aamna is a name derived from the Arabic root عَمَنَ (amana), meaning 'to trust', 'to place reliance'. In the Islamic context, it signifies the trust and faith that one has in Allah and His guidance, as well as the trustworthiness and reliability of a person. The name Aamna carries the meaning “Trust, faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aamna usually hope their child will grow to embody trust, faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with trust and faith in Allah.
data.etymology: Aamna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust, faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamna total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

It is a name given to girls, and it is believed that those bearing the name symbolize the strong bond of trust that is essential in the Islamic community, both in social and religious aspects. The value of trust is highly emphasized in Islamic teachings and is considered a fundamental aspect of building strong relationships and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Aamna signifies the trust and faith that one has in Allah, the unwavering belief in His existence, and the reliance on His guidance and mercy. It reminds us of our duty to be trustworthy and reliable in our actions and words, striving to be a model of good character and behavior. The name also underlines the importance of having trust and faith in the promises of Allah, and seeking His protection and refuge in times of uncertainty and hardship. Ultimately, the name Aamna encourages us to place our trust in Allah, and to be a source of trust and reliability for others in our community.
